data.title: Round-Dollar Wire Amount Pattern
data.description: Detects unusual patterns of wire transfers in round dollar amounts (e.g., $5,000, $10,000, $25,000). While individual round-amount wires are common, a pattern of multiple round-amount wires is atypical for legitimate business payments and may indicate structured or test transactions by fraudsters.
falsepositives: Loan disbursements or payments that are inherently round amounts
